compiled_state.author: Joe Oakhart
compiled_state.description: Consolidate the code review bot's per-criterion Opus passes (currently 7 sequential passes over full change context per review) into batched criteria passes, mirroring the batching plan review already uses. Expected to reduce both per-review cost and peak-day aggregate spend. Acceptance: reviews produce equivalent verdicts on the gold set; per-review token usage measurably reduced; unit-cost dashboard reflects the change.
compiled_state.title: Batch code-review criteria into consolidated passes
